issues.explanation: The adaptation says Sun Quan had Zhou Yu richly buried before Kongming travels to Chaisang to mourn him, but the source has Zhou Yu’s coffin still at Chaisang during Kongming’s visit; burial occurs later at Wuhu.
issues.suggested_fix: Move or remove the burial statement. Replace it with wording such as “孙权命鲁肃接任，周瑜灵柩暂运柴桑，并优待其儿女。”
